import re
from datetime import datetime

# login to file_system
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pass = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_user = 'ja-solomon@gmail.com'
access_token = apis.file_system.login(username=fs_user, password=fs_pass)['access_token']

now = datetime.now()
year = now.year

listing = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/electricity', entry_type='all', recursive=True)

# collect month-specific files for this year
pat = re.compile(rf"/({year})-(\d{{2}})\.(txt|pdf)$")
month_files = {}
for p in listing:
    m = pat.search(p)
    if not m:
        continue
    y, mm, ext = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
    key = f"{y}-{mm}"
    month_files.setdefault(key, []).append(p)

print('month_files keys:', sorted(month_files.keys()))
for k in sorted(month_files.keys()):
    print(k, '->', month_files[k])

# choose preference: txt over pdf
chosen = {}
for k, paths in month_files.items():
    txts = [p for p in paths if p.endswith('.txt')]
    if txts:
        # if multiple txts, pick one lexicographically
        chosen[k] = sorted(txts)[0]
    else:
        chosen[k] = sorted([p for p in paths if p.endswith('.pdf')])[0]

print('chosen per month:', chosen)

pattern = re.compile(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9][0-9\.,]*)", re.IGNORECASE)

total_sum = 0.0
parsed = []
for k in sorted(chosen.keys()):
    p = chosen[k]
    resp = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p)
    text = resp.get('content','') or ''
    m = pattern.search(text)
    if not m:
        print('NO MATCH for', k, p)
        continue
    num = float(m.group(1).replace(',',''))
    parsed.append((k,p,num))
    total_sum += num
    print('parsed', k, p, '=>', num)

print('parsed count:', len(parsed))
print('total_sum:', total_sum)

]

total = 0.0
pattern_total = re.compile(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9][0-9\.,]*)", re.IGNORECASE)
pattern_elec = re.compile(r"Electricity Bill|Electricity Charges", re.IGNORECASE)

matched = []

    text = resp.get('content','') or ''
    if not pattern_elec.search(text):
        continue
    m = pattern_total.search(text)
    if not m:
        print('no Total Amount match:', p)
        continue
    num = float(m.group(1).replace(',',''))
    matched.append((p,num))
    total += num
    print('matched', p, '=>', num)

print('matched count:', len(matched))
print('total:', total)
